# Bid the walls, the hopper, and the stairs.

> Price a residential vinyl pool liner from the liner square feet a water-surface special cannot see, the hopper, the stairs, and the track — plus walk-away price and proposed-price margin check.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
